name: viewport-guard
description: Your whale-girl lookout for responsive layouts: audit, compare, and inspect offline.
author: Pasukalu

scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm test && npm run smoke
scripts.desktop:pack: npm run build && npm run desktop:prepare-browser && electron-builder --config electron-builder.json --dir
scripts.desktop:portable: npm run build && npm run desktop:prepare-browser && electron-builder --config electron-builder.json --win portable --x64
scripts.desktop:dist: npm run build && npm run desktop:prepare-browser && electron-builder --config electron-builder.json --win dir portable nsis --x64
scripts.desktop:dist:win: npm run build && npm run desktop:prepare-browser && electron-builder --config electron-builder.json --win dir portable nsis --x64
scripts.desktop:dist:mac: npm run build && npm run desktop:prepare-browser && electron-builder --config electron-builder.json --mac dmg zip
scripts.desktop:dist:mac:arm64: npm run build && npm run desktop:prepare-browser && electron-builder --config electron-builder.json --mac dmg zip --arm64
scripts.desktop:dist:mac:x64: npm run build && npm run desktop:prepare-browser && electron-builder --config electron-builder.json --mac dmg zip --x64
scripts.desktop:dist:linux: npm run build && npm run desktop:prepare-browser && electron-builder --config electron-builder.json --linux AppImage deb tar.gz
scripts.desktop:dist:linux:x64: npm run build && npm run desktop:prepare-browser && electron-builder --config electron-builder.json --linux AppImage deb tar.gz --x64
scripts.desktop:dist:linux:arm64: npm run build && npm run desktop:prepare-browser && electron-builder --config electron-builder.json --linux AppImage deb tar.gz --arm64
